department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India (run by PFRDA)
benefit: A pension for your old age. You pay a small amount every month, quarter or half year until age 60. After 60, you get a guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000, Rs 3,000, Rs 4,000 or Rs 5,000 a month for life. After you die, your husband or wife gets the same pension. After both die, your nominee gets the saved money.

other: You must be a citizen of India with a savings bank account.

how_to_apply: Fill the APY form and give it to your bank or post office. Your payment is taken from your savings account by auto-debit until you turn 60.
where_to_apply: Any bank (including regional rural and co-operative banks), or the post office
